name: Erwin Gates
source:
| LV: 80 | Rogue |

Erwin Gates is a lot of things. The richest and, perhaps self-proclaimed, smartest man alive, the mayor of the illustrious Perk City, a business man, and a World-Class Hero. He's other things too, but he doesn't like talking about those. Actually, it seems he's hiding a lot behind that smile and wink.

(Taken from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31456"]Lemma Soft thread[/url])
